categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: computer and server chassis and components (29%), power supply units (39%), and proprietary brand computer gaming peripherals (22%). Additional minor segments include medical and home beds (2%) and other products (8%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced power supply designs such as programmable digital control ICs implementing LLC+PFC architectures for high efficiency, and development of high-wattage titanium-grade power supplies. Production methods involve automated manufacturing processes, digital punching for chassis design, and modular open-frame chassis development. The company also integrates firmware/software for digital cooling products and employs EMI shielding and noise reduction techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international brands primarily in the computer and IT sectors. The company serves global markets with a focus on Asia, Europe, and the Americas. It targets OEM/ODM clients, system integrators, and retail channels, especially in gaming and AI PC markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Asia (35%), Europe (20%), and the Americas (43%), with manufacturing facilities mainly in Taiwan and China. The company has subsidiaries and sales offices in the US, Japan, Korea, Mexico, and Hong Kong, supporting a global supply and sales network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream manufacturing segment, producing key components such as power supplies and chassis for downstream OEMs and system integrators. It also has upstream integration in transformer and wiring production and downstream proprietary brand product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic R&D focuses on AI server chassis, high-wattage power supplies for AI workstations, digital power supplies with advanced control features, and differentiated gaming peripherals under the Cougar brand. The company emphasizes automation, energy efficiency, modular design, and integration of digital display technologies in cooling products. Collaboration with AI industry leaders and flexible production partnerships are key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power supplies, computer chassis, and gaming peripherals. The company also earns from ODM/OEM manufacturing contracts and proprietary brand product sales. Licensing or subscription models are not indicated.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes globally in the computer chassis and power supply manufacturing industry, holding an estimated 4% global market share in PC power supplies. It differentiates through high-quality, mid-to-high-end products and strong OEM/ODM capabilities. Competitors include other global PC component manufacturers and gaming peripheral brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, consolidated revenue was approximately NT$7.4 billion, with a net profit of NT$639 million and EPS of NT$4.61. The company experienced a slight revenue decline (~9%) compared to the previous year but maintains stable profitability and a solid asset base of NT$9.5 billion. It invests significantly in R&D (~NT$165 million in 2023) and pursues steady growth through product innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product differentiation through innovative chassis designs with superior cooling and EMI shielding, high-efficiency and quiet power supplies compliant with latest standards (e.g., Intel ATX 3.1), and integrated digital features in cooling products. Its Cougar brand offers unique ergonomic gaming chairs and peripherals, enhancing brand recognition and customer loyalty. The company also leverages flexible manufacturing partnerships and global supply chain integration to meet diverse customer needs.
